_doc: Plausibility limits for the PSOC Edge E84 AI Kit sensors, board lying still on a desk, room 15-35 C (the kit itself runs ~10 C warmer). Field names = TAG.key printed by templates/sensors. Tune with evidence; note the date and board in 'why'.

ENV.t.why: SHT40 temperature; the running kit heats it to ~40 C

ENV.p.why: DPS368 pressure in Pa (sea level ~101325, -12 Pa per m altitude)

ENV.tp.why: DPS368 temperature (next to the MCU, warmest)

IMU.amag.why: BMI270 |a| at rest = 1 g; outside = moving or wrong range scaling

IMU.gx.why: BMI270 gyro zero-rate offset at rest (mdps)

IMU.gy.why: BMI270 gyro zero-rate offset at rest (mdps)

IMU.gz.why: BMI270 gyro zero-rate offset at rest (mdps)

MAG.bmag.why: BMM350 |B| in nT; 2026-10-10 tesaiot shows a ~2.5 mT board-fixed offset, so only a wide window until hard-iron calibration exists
